description: Checks an economy spec. Returns its refusals, each with a code, what it means and its fix, which keep a spec from going live; and its warnings, what the person behind the economy needs to know: chance that pays money, revenue paid to stakers, an unfunded prize, a grant without limits, a mint’s powers, a time far off (with its date in words), a token a player can hold a payment up in, a box longer than one answer of the oracle’s holds. The program refuses only what it must, so much of what a project sets up is accepted with a warning. Also returns how many wallet approvals each action takes. Takes the spec inline (`spec`) or a worked example by name.

example.description: A worked example by name (stud-farm, nft-raffle, …).

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_check
title: Check an economy spec
